row.evidence: Clari's pricing URL now redirects to Salesloft's Talk to Sales page, and the Okta catalogue lists the Clari app for Single Sign-On only; no public Clari SCIM documentation was found.
row.notes: Quote-only: clari.com/pricing redirects to salesloft.com/see-it-live; Clari merged into Salesloft and Clari Forecast keeps the Clari name. Okta's OIN Clari app is SAML/SWA (last updated 2016) with no provisioning. Clari's support community (clari.my.site.com) requires login, so any SCIM or SSO setup docs are not public. The Clari API (api.clari.com/v4) covers forecast, activity and data export plus an Audit API; it documents no user-management endpoints. Salesloft help centre SCIM articles cover Salesloft and Drift, not Clari Forecast.
